scope: Review of current tracked specification changes across base and both harness roots, against local feature contracts and adjacent normative sections. No runtime implementation or live host compatibility certification. Work records are historical evidence, not executable contracts.

findings.title: Preserve the exact-approved-edit exception for review role
findings.finding: The revised review procedure and output prohibit all body writes. Both base feature contracts explicitly permit applying an exact user-approved edit under review, and the Claude feature hook implements that exception. A user approving a precise correction would be refused by the new shared procedure but allowed by the feature contracts and Claude guard.
findings.recommendation: Restore the distinction between authoring a body/draft and applying an exact approved edit. If removal of that exception is intended, obtain a feature-contract decision and reconcile those contracts first; do not silently change the policy in architecture.
verification_required: Review role refuses autonomous drafting and unapproved edits.
An exact user-approved correction can be applied, with no extra text changes or lifecycle approval.
Shared procedure and both harnesses use the same rule.

findings.title: Use resolved prospective inputs during rebase and cherry-pick conflict recovery
findings.finding: The snapshot exception is specified only for an in-progress merge; every other standalone invocation uses HEAD. A rebase (including explicit restack) can stop with a PLANS.md conflict and resolved staged PLAN.md changes, without MERGE_HEAD. Following the stated rule generates the pre-resolution index from HEAD, omitting the resolved plan/config changes. Continuing then commits an index that differs from regeneration at the resulting commit. Cherry-pick conflict recovery has the same uncovered case.
findings.recommendation: Define prospective stage-0 snapshot selection for supported sequencer/conflict-resolution operations as well as merges, rechecking the appropriate operation identity. Refuse unsupported or ambiguous recovery rather than writing a knowingly stale index.
verification_required: Rebase/restack conflict with resolved staged plan/config inputs generates their prospective index.
Cherry-pick conflict receives equivalent handling or an explicit safe refusal.
Regeneration after continuation is byte-identical; unresolved/unstaged inputs refuse without writes.

findings.title: Reconcile the edit-triggered generation hook with HEAD-only generation
findings.finding: The optional Claude auto-generation hook still runs ordinary specplane generate immediately after Edit/Write of PLAN.md. Under the new standalone snapshot rule that command excludes the very edit that triggered it. New plans are absent and changed titles/statuses stay at their prior committed values; the hook has no subsequent post-commit trigger. It therefore no longer provides the advertised auto-generation behavior.
findings.recommendation: Specify a coherent trigger and snapshot contract: an explicitly scoped prospective-generation operation, or regeneration after the relevant committed inputs change. If the feature behavior changes, propose and obtain approval for that feature text rather than silently narrowing it.
verification_required: Enable the hook in a consumer fixture, create/edit a plan, and demonstrate when the generated index actually includes that revision.
Preserve unrelated dirty inputs and avoid claiming that HEAD output incorporates an excluded edit.
